name: Mecha HUD
author: sazardev
description: Halo-style tactical Omarchy command panel: ping, CPU, RAM, battery, objectives, radar and live wallpaper controls.

barWidget.description: A military-green command screen with NET latency, THRT CPU load, AMMO RAM pressure, objectives, radar and a NEXT LIVE wallpaper control.

schema.label: Ping host
schema.description: Host or IP used for the NET latency readout.

schema.label: Ping interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the NET readout sends one ICMP echo request.

schema.label: Show PWR
schema.description: Display the battery readout when a battery is present.
